name: pixbar
description: A pixel creature above the prompt or in its own pane: the whale in a sea or clawd skating on land. Uncommitted work leaves plants and litter on the floor. Context colours it, the five-hour window sets its height or the time of day. /pixbar theme <name> picks one.

theme.title: Which creature
theme.description: whale: swims in a sea. clawd: skates on land. /pixbar theme <name> picks one too, your own skins included; whichever you set last is used.

placement.title: Where the creature lives
placement.description: band: above the prompt. pane: a pane of its own, docked beside the transcript in fullscreen. /pixbar layout band or /pixbar layout pane switches for the session.
